Endurant Capital Management LP Decreased Its Medtronic Plc (MDT) Holding by $913,297 as Shares Rose; Wharton Business Group Has Cut Its Position in Apple (AAPL) by $447,678 as Stock Rose 
March 11, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Wharton Business Group Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.8% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wharton Business Group Llc sold 2,907 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 158,294 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $24.40M, down from 161,201 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wharton Business Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $913.22B market cap company. The stock increased 1.72% or $3.04   $179.98. About 32.19 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
